title: Kobalos Backdoor Investigation Exercise
description: Investigate a Kobalos backdoor infection in a multi-host sandbox environment.

levels.title: Kobalos Backdoor Investigation Overview
levels.content: You are a member of the incident response team at CyberRangeCZ. A recent MISP event has reported a Kobalos backdoor infection in one of our systems. Your task is to investigate this incident, identify the compromised hosts, and gather evidence to support your findings.

levels.title: Accessing the Sandbox Environment
levels.cloud_content: Connect to the target host using SSH with the provided credentials: username: cyrano, password: cyrano.
levels.local_content: The target host's IP address is 192.168.50.5.

levels.title: Identify Kobalos Backdoor Artifacts
levels.solution: Use the `locate` command or manually search for files with known Kobalos hashes in the /tmp directory.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Look for files with known Kobalos hashes in the /tmp directory.

levels.title: Investigate Network Connections
levels.solution: Use `netstat -an | grep LISTEN` or `ss -tuln` commands to inspect active connections and listen ports on the target host.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Use `netstat` or `ss` commands to inspect active connections and listen ports on the target host.

levels.title: Gather Evidence and Report Findings
levels.solution: Use `ls`, `cat`, or other commands to gather relevant files, logs, and indicators of compromise (IOCs). Write a brief report summarizing your investigation results.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Collect evidence of the Kobalos backdoor infection on the target host and prepare a report summarizing your findings.
